rationale: Round 2 has sharpened positions into a stable impasse: labour and the state reaffirm absolute no-closure/no-forced-layoff lines, while management and investors insist those tools remain on the table if needed for durable savings. Both sides now request quantified alternatives, but no substantive movement on the core contested issues is visible, so further rounds are likely to circle without resolution unless a facilitator restructures the discussion around shared numbers and trade-off scenarios.
